text: [calm, natural narrator voice] One caution: <|phoneme_start|>R AY1 S<|phoneme_end|> counts crossings, not reversals. An excursion across zero and back adds two crossings, but no reversal. To isolate reversals, the PhD plan counts crossings of a far level, on the other side.
